correctness.rationale: Exact translation of unselected-edge one-neighbor domination to three local Boolean clauses. The standard-library finite-state checker enumerates all 512 triples, verifies 42 involved states, 102 arcs, and precisely cyclic SCCs of lengths 1 and 6; all other SCCs are acyclic, proving the only cyclic labelings. The 6-cycle has weight six per traversal and six labelled phases. Independent direct subset enumeration agrees for n=3..6, plus an independent C++17 search for n=3..7. The finite-order checks support but do not replace the infinite closed-walk argument.

value.rationale: A complete structural classification in a natural infinite family of cubic graphs not chordal or generalized series-parallel, with a sharp mod-six existence transition and a discontinuous factor-three change in optimum cardinality. It produces a two-term whole-set polynomial, six canonical solutions and a tractable benchmark for the 2026 counting problem. The new boundary-resonance statement is not implied by the earlier open-ladder cardinality counts; this is more than a small numerical improvement.
